segments.name: regional and community/power shopping centers
segments.description: Owns and leases regional and community shopping centers.
segments.evidence: Segment Reporting: The Company operates as one operating segment and is involved in the acquisition, ownership, development, redevelopment, management and leasing of regional and community/power shopping centers located throughout the United States.

revenueModel.text: Retail tenants pay rent and recoveries.
revenueModel.evidence: The CODM assesses performance for the Company's single reportable segment and decides how to allocate resources based on consolidated net income (see the Consolidated Statements of Operations).
